title: Quiz: If Statements
description: Check your understanding of If Statements.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Swift?
questions.explanation: In Swift, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What happens when an if condition is false and there is no else?
questions.explanation: Without else, a false condition simply skips the block.

questions.question: True or False: undefined
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: $if score >= 60 { ... }
questions.explanation: The if keyword starts a conditional.

questions.question: In Swift, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
